$comment: Life events about the town and its founders (D-068). `founder` events need that founder with you ({founder}); never your own character.

events.title: Which way to the clinic?
events.prompt: {name} is turning in slow circles with a dead phone. "Sorry, which way is Riverdale Clinic? I've only been here a week."

outcomes.text: You walk them there and point out the good coffee on the way. They say Livéra is friendlier than they'd heard.

memory.text: Walked {name}, a newcomer, all the way to the clinic.

outcomes.text: You point, with confidence. You're about seventy percent sure you pointed the right way.
"No idea, sorry." You know exactly where it is. You're just late.

events.title: The sound of progress
events.prompt: The site crew has been jackhammering since seven. The foreman sees your face and holds out a pair of earplugs and a sheepish grin.

choices.label: Take the earplugs, ask what's going up

outcomes.text: He talks you through the plans with real pride. Suddenly the noise sounds like the town getting bigger.

memory.text: A foreman showed me what the town is building.

outcomes.text: You complain. He nods. The jackhammer continues, at roughly the same volume as your complaint.

events.title: The town meeting
events.prompt: Common Ground is packed and loud: a meeting about what the town should build next. Someone is waving a petition about parking.

outcomes.text: Your voice shakes for the first sentence, then it doesn't. People clap. Someone asks your name.

memory.text: Spoke up at the town meeting.

outcomes.text: You stand, open your mouth, and forget everything. You say "…more benches?" and sit down. Some people nod.

memory.text: Froze speaking at the town meeting. Suggested benches.

outcomes.text: You listen. Livéra is arguing with itself about its own future, and it feels like it's yours too.
You slip out during the parking debate. Nobody blames you.

events.title: Someone else's picnic
events.prompt: Someone has left their whole picnic by the water: takeaway boxes, a bottle, a sad paper crown.

outcomes.text: You bin the lot. A passing jogger gives you a thumbs-up. You'll take it.

memory.text: Cleaned up litter by the lake.

outcomes.text: You put on the paper crown. You are the monarch of this mess. You bin the mess, regally.
Not your picnic, not your problem. The crown watches you go.

events.title: On the record
events.prompt: {founder} from the Livéra Ledger holds out a recorder. "Quick one for the paper: what would make this town better?"

outcomes.text: You talk about the river path and the night bus. {founder} writes fast. Your words are in Thursday's paper.

memory.text: Was quoted in the Livéra Ledger.

outcomes.text: "A second bakery." {founder} laughs out loud. It's the pull-quote on page three.

memory.text: My joke made the Livéra Ledger.

outcomes.text: {founder} smiles politely and moves on to someone with an opinion.
"No comment." You feel briefly like a celebrity. You are not.

events.title: Many hands
events.prompt: {founder} is unloading crates outside Common Ground, alone. "Don't suppose you've got an hour?"

outcomes.text: An hour becomes two. You learn where the pantry gets its tins and how {founder} takes her tea.
You press a twenty into her hand. "For the pantry." {founder} squeezes your arm.
"Sorry, I'm late for something." She waves you off kindly, which is worse.

events.title: Tell me honestly
events.prompt: {founder} hands you one earbud. "New track. Tell me honestly." It's… a lot of bass.

outcomes.text: "The hook's great. The middle drags." {founder} goes quiet, then grins. "You're right. Nobody says that."

memory.text: Gave {founder} honest notes on a track.

outcomes.text: "The middle drags." {founder} takes the earbud back a little fast. "Cool. Cool cool."
"It's a banger." {founder} beams. You'll hear it in every shop in town by Friday.

events.title: Ground floor
events.prompt: {founder} has a napkin covered in arrows. "Hear me out. An app for… you know what, put in $50 and you'll be on the ground floor."

outcomes.text: Weeks later, {founder} pays you back double with a hug. "Told you. Ground floor."

memory.text: Backed {founder}'s napkin idea. It paid off.

outcomes.text: The napkin pivots twice and then becomes a different napkin. Your $50 is now "equity."
You ask who pays for it. {founder} stares at the napkin for a long time. "Huh."
"Ground floor of what?" {founder} laughs and pockets the napkin. "Fair."
